application.description: Supplier-direct lumber sales, Florida field visits, deliveries, recurring business, and commissions
application.aboutDescription:
# Lumber Distribution

A Twenty CRM app for arranging lumber shipments directly from suppliers to customers, with Florida field sales and product demonstrations. The name is a working label; business branding, products, regions and terms can change later. Monetary fields use USD in this first version.

This app extends Twenty rather than replacing its core. A running Twenty instance **2.58.0 or later** is required. The GitHub repository by itself is not a hosted CRM.

## What the first version includes

| Area | How to use it |
| --- | --- |
| Companies and people | Keep existing contacts; add customer/supplier role, region, county and follow-up information. |
| Products | Link a supplier; record optional species, grade, dimensions, treatment, units, reference prices, samples and lead times. |
| Site visits | Schedule a customer visit, link a contact and sample product, record samples shown, photos, feedback and the next action. |
| Orders and order lines | Record quotes and confirmed orders separately; agree quantities, measurement units, pricing units, prices, supplier and delivery address. |
| Shipment lots | Link each delivery portion to one order line, with quantity, unit, reference, expected/actual dates and delay notes. |
| Reorder plans | Store the repeat interval in months, next need date, review date and active/paused state. Review dates surface work before the next delivery is needed. |
| Commissions | Keep the commission basis and rate unset until agreed; track expected and received commission and each side's payouts separately. |
| Lumber Overview | See confirmed order value, planned visits, undelivered shipment lots, commission amounts and sales/delivery status charts. |

No warehouse stock or inventory ownership is assumed. Companies and People remain Twenty's existing records.

## A first customer

1. Add the prospect under **Companies**, then its contact under **People**. Record a region/county and the next follow-up.
2. Add the supplier and a product. Specifications may remain blank while the catalog is being developed.
3. Schedule a **Site visit**. Record which samples were shown or left, the customer's feedback and the next action.
4. Create an **Order** as a quote; add its **Order lines**. Keep quantity and pricing units explicit: 1,000 board feet and 1 thousand board feet represent the same volume but different pricing quantities.
5. Confirm the order when the customer agrees. Customer payment status is independent of sales and shipment status.
6. Add a **Shipment lot** for each order line/delivery portion. For 1,000 board feet delivered in two portions, use lots of 400 and 600. Use the same shipment reference for multiple lots travelling together. Lot counts on the dashboard are not truck counts.
7. Add a **Commission** linked to the order. Agree the eligible amount/basis and rate before marking terms confirmed. The calculation must not assume freight or tax is commissionable.
8. Record commission money received and payouts when they actually happen. Delivery alone does not imply payment.
9. For repeat business, create a **Reorder plan** and its review date. A plan represents anticipated business; a new confirmed order still requires customer agreement.

## Commission terms

Order value, commission income and your allocation are different amounts. For an illustrative $20,000 eligible amount at 5%, expected commission is $1,000. A confirmed 50/50 split would allocate $500 to your side and $500 to the partner pool. Partner-pool allocation is not $500 per individual partner.

The split remains a proposal until **Split confirmed** is checked. Confirm the intended partner arrangement before doing that. An unknown rate is **TBD**, not 0%. Rates and terms are stored on individual commission records so later deals can use different agreements.

Commission-created and commission-updated handlers recalculate expected commission and allocations from the current agreed terms. Received amounts and payouts remain actual amounts entered separately. Calculation helpers use integer money and currency-cent rounding; the current calculator supports USD. Reconcile payout history with accounting records.

## Recurring business

Reorder plans store calendar-month intervals and review dates. The planning tool calculates a review date from supplier lead time plus a review buffer and clamps month-end dates (for example January 31 to February 28/29). It previews dates; it does not create orders, send messages, or schedule supplier shipments. Use the review views alongside Twenty tasks for follow-up.

## Install and validate

See [SETUP.md](./SETUP.md) for installation into an existing workspace, local development and isolated tests. Nothing is installed into a live workspace until `twenty app apply --create` succeeds.

The app has no external commerce integrations, automatic supplier booking, customer invoicing or public customer portal. Shipment totals and order/line values should be reconciled when entering a transaction; this version does not automatically convert quantity units or enforce aggregate lot quantities across all deliveries.

fields.name: shipmentReference
fields.label: Shipment reference
fields.description: Use the same reference on lots belonging to one multi-line consignment.

fields.name: quantity
fields.label: Lot quantity
fields.description: This lot is a quantity allocated to a single order line.

fields.name: orderValue
fields.label: Order value
fields.description: Total customer order value; separate from commission income.

fields.name: samplesShown
fields.label: Samples shown / left
fields.description: List product names, sample references, and whether samples were left with the customer.

fields.name: notes
fields.label: Planning notes
fields.description: Confirm quantity, price and availability with the customer before creating a new order.

fields.name: commissionRate
fields.label: Commission rate (%)
fields.description: Leave unset until agreed. Zero is an agreed zero rate, not TBD.

fields.name: eligibleBasis
fields.label: Eligible commission basis
fields.description: Specify whether freight, taxes, discounts and other charges qualify.

fields.name: eligibleAmount
fields.label: Eligible amount
fields.description: Agreed commissionable amount, which may differ from customer order value.

fields.name: expectedCommission
fields.label: Expected commission
fields.description: Calculated from confirmed commission terms; not money received.

fields.name: receivedCommission
fields.label: Commission received
fields.description: Cumulative commission actually received; delivery or customer payment does not imply receipt.

fields.name: splitTerms
fields.label: Split agreement / partner pool
fields.description: Confirm whether the other 50% belongs to partners collectively before calculating allocations.

fields.name: referencePrice
fields.label: Reference price
fields.description: Indicative price per pricing unit; each order records its own agreed terms.

fields.name: pricingQuantity
fields.label: Pricing quantity
fields.description: Quantity expressed in the pricing unit; do not multiply board feet by a per-MBF price without conversion.

fields.name: lineValue
fields.label: Agreed line value
fields.description: Store the agreed value; no automatic conversion between quantity and pricing units.

roles.label: Lumber Distribution default function role
roles.description: Read commission terms and update calculated commission amounts.

logicFunctions.name: on-commission-updated
logicFunctions.description: Recalculate confirmed commissions from the current saved terms, leaving unknown earnings blank.

logicFunctions.name: calculate-commissions
logicFunctions.description: Preview USD commissions and confirmed partner-pool splits without changing records.

logicFunctions.name: on-commission-created
logicFunctions.description: Recalculate confirmed commissions from the current saved terms, leaving unknown earnings blank.

logicFunctions.name: plan-reorders
logicFunctions.description: Preview reorder review dates and calendar-month intervals without creating orders.

validationRules.name: positive-shipment-quantity
validationRules.message: Shipment lot quantity must be positive when entered.

validationRules.name: confirmed-commission-split
validationRules.message: A confirmed split needs shares totaling 100% and written terms identifying the partner pool.
validationRules.expression: splitConfirmed != true or (isDefined(yourSharePercent) and isDefined(partnerPoolSharePercent) and yourSharePercent + partnerPoolSharePercent == 100 and isNonEmptyString(splitTerms))

validationRules.name: nonnegative-commission-amounts
validationRules.message: Commission receipts, eligible amount and payouts cannot be negative.
validationRules.expression: (not isDefined(eligibleAmount.amountMicros) or eligibleAmount.amountMicros >= 0) and (not isDefined(receivedCommission.amountMicros) or receivedCommission.amountMicros >= 0) and (not isDefined(yourPaid.amountMicros) or yourPaid.amountMicros >= 0) and (not isDefined(partnerPoolPaid.amountMicros) or partnerPoolPaid.amountMicros >= 0)

validationRules.name: order-line-units
validationRules.message: Choose an explicit unit for each entered quantity.
validationRules.expression: (not isDefined(quantity) or isDefined(quantityUnit)) and (not isDefined(pricingQuantity) or isDefined(pricingUnit))

validationRules.name: product-usd-amounts
validationRules.message: Use USD for all amounts in this first version. Currency conversion is not supported.

validationRules.name: positive-reorder-period
validationRules.message: Repeat months and quantity must be positive; planning lead time cannot be negative.
validationRules.expression: (not isDefined(repeatMonths) or repeatMonths > 0) and (not isDefined(expectedQuantity) or expectedQuantity > 0) and (not isDefined(leadTimeDays) or leadTimeDays >= 0)

validationRules.name: commission-usd-amounts
validationRules.message: Use USD for all amounts in this first version. Currency conversion is not supported.
validationRules.expression: (not isDefined(eligibleAmount.amountMicros) or eligibleAmount.currencyCode == "USD") and (not isDefined(expectedCommission.amountMicros) or expectedCommission.currencyCode == "USD") and (not isDefined(receivedCommission.amountMicros) or receivedCommission.currencyCode == "USD") and (not isDefined(yourExpectedShare.amountMicros) or yourExpectedShare.currencyCode == "USD") and (not isDefined(partnerPoolExpectedShare.amountMicros) or partnerPoolExpectedShare.currencyCode == "USD") and (not isDefined(yourPaid.amountMicros) or yourPaid.currencyCode == "USD") and (not isDefined(partnerPoolPaid.amountMicros) or partnerPoolPaid.currencyCode == "USD")

validationRules.name: product-lead-time
validationRules.message: Lead time must be zero or a positive number of days.

validationRules.name: commission-percentage-ranges
validationRules.message: Commission and split percentages must be between 0 and 100.
validationRules.expression: (not isDefined(commissionRate) or (commissionRate >= 0 and commissionRate <= 100)) and (not isDefined(yourSharePercent) or (yourSharePercent >= 0 and yourSharePercent <= 100)) and (not isDefined(partnerPoolSharePercent) or (partnerPoolSharePercent >= 0 and partnerPoolSharePercent <= 100))

validationRules.name: order-line-usd-amounts
validationRules.message: Use USD for all amounts in this first version. Currency conversion is not supported.
validationRules.expression: (not isDefined(unitPrice.amountMicros) or unitPrice.currencyCode == "USD") and (not isDefined(lineValue.amountMicros) or lineValue.currencyCode == "USD")

validationRules.name: positive-order-quantities
validationRules.message: Ordered and pricing quantities must be positive when entered.
validationRules.expression: (not isDefined(quantity) or quantity > 0) and (not isDefined(pricingQuantity) or pricingQuantity > 0)

validationRules.name: order-usd-amounts
validationRules.message: Use USD for all amounts in this first version. Currency conversion is not supported.

validationRules.name: confirmed-commission-terms
validationRules.message: Confirm the commission rate, eligible USD amount and basis before confirming terms.
validationRules.expression: status != "CONFIRMED" or (isDefined(commissionRate) and isDefined(eligibleAmount.amountMicros) and eligibleAmount.amountMicros >= 0 and eligibleAmount.currencyCode == "USD" and isNonEmptyString(eligibleBasis))

validationRules.name: delivered-shipment-date
validationRules.message: A delivered lot needs its actual delivery date and positive quantity.
validationRules.expression: status != "DELIVERED" or (isDefined(deliveredAt) and isDefined(quantity) and quantity > 0)

validationRules.name: shipment-unit
validationRules.message: Choose the unit for this shipment lot quantity.
